$comment: The Bundu floor's hit-region rules, as cases both evaluators must answer identically: contracts/runner.ts (hitViolations) and mzizi-rs/contract-eval (hit_violations). `fine` and `coarse` are the drawn heights in px (null: the runner could not read one); `violations` is how many sentences each returns. Pinned by __tests__/density.test.ts and mzizi-ui's tests/contracts_json.rs.

cases.name: a button drawn at 36px keeps its hit region through the pseudo-element
a button drawn under 28px is too small to draw
a link has only its box
a native field drawn at 49px is fine
a native field drawn at 48px fails on both pointers
a button with its own after: utility keeps only its box
a button that clips its overflow keeps only its box
a menu row takes min-height, so a short row is covered
a menu row with its own min-h-* is only its box
a listbox option is a composite row too
a calendar day is a grid cell, left as drawn
a row the runner cannot read is skipped
